name: Australia

format.notes: Multiple choice. Five of the 20 questions are on Australian values and all five must be answered correctly, with at least 75 per cent overall.

exemptions.age: People aged 60 or over do not sit the test; they may be interviewed and asked to show they understand the nature of their application.
exemptions.disability: People with a permanent or enduring physical or mental incapacity may be asked to verify it; a support person and an interpreter can attend.

official_study_material.title: Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond (testable section)

unverified.format.time_limit_minutes: The pages read do not state the time allowed; the page describing the test itself could not be opened.
unverified.format.question_pool_size: The test questions are not published; only a practice test is.
unverified.fee: No fee for the test itself is stated on the pages read.

notes: All test questions are based on Our Common Bond, which is also published in community languages; the test itself is in English only. The department publishes a practice test, not the live question bank.
